name: com.coverup.splatter
description: Procedural paint splatter for Unity: seed-deterministic splats built from measured rules, a composition layer that lays a whole painting, and a GPU painter with an outer glow. Pure C# generation, UnityEngine-only painting, no render pipeline dependency.

samples.description: A full-screen backdrop that paints a composition progressively, then keeps adding splats and dissolving the oldest.
